sections.heading: Overview
Project goals

sections.content:
Sydney Trains seeks a suitably qualified Contractor to provide end-to-end management and delivery of Testing, Inspection, Calibration and Servicing (TICS) services for Minor Plant and Equipment (MPE) across the Network Maintenance Division.

The Contractor will be responsible for coordinating, managing and/or undertaking TICS activities for more than 8,000 assets located across 8 Network Bases, 3 Network Satellites and associated minor sites throughout the Sydney metropolitan rail network.The scope includes management of all TICS categories, including testing and inspection, calibration, servicing, electrical testing equipment, lifting and rigging equipment, fall arrest equipment, ladders, first aid equipment, meters and measuring devices, test and tag services, and OEM-specific equipment requiring authorised service providers.

The successful Contractor will act as the single point of accountability for service scheduling, subcontractor management, compliance monitoring, reporting, invoicing, risk management and continuous improvement. Services must be delivered in accordance with relevant Sydney Trains standards, manufacturer requirements and applicable industry standards, including ISO/IEC 17025 and other recognised accreditation frameworks.
